integrity: Finite laws are derived by the exponential infection-time decomposition and verified with an independent exact-state checker and seeded static-edge simulations; computational checks alone cannot certify the infinite asymptotics. Historical priority and independent mathematical verification have not been established.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic law fixes the petal clique size m >= 2 as n grows. The m=1 star is a separate boundary. Homogeneous, independent exponential edge passage times and a unique central hub are essential. All-size finite laws, not a growing-petal-size extension, are proved.
title: Clique-bouquet flooding: a sharp \(\log\log n\) shift and a harmonic source penalty
